title: Good faith immunity.
bodyText: Law enforcement agencies, employees of law enforcement agencies, and state and county officials shall be immune from liability for good faith conduct under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§846E-8]  Good faith immunity.  Law enforcement agencies, employees of law enforcement agencies, and state and county officials shall be immune from liability for good faith conduct under this chapter. [L 1997, c 316, pt of §2]
